blockers.consequence: Pixel equivalence with the origin is `origin-formula` (an independent float64 evaluation of its shader), never golden equivalence. Matrix status for visual parity stays partial.
blockers.detail: The origin golden (catalog/__golden__/vignette.png, a strip drawn at 320x180 over the origin's own test plates, tolerance 2/255 on 0.5% of pixels) needs its harness: a build of the engine and a browser, i.e. executing the origin. That is forbidden in this delivery, and the plates are not part of the snapshot's blobs listed here. No golden was invented and none is compared.

blockers.consequence: A future execution of the origin (in its own, authorised environment) may replace `origin-formula` by `origin-output` per case.
blockers.detail: Expectations are transcribed formulas, not the origin's outputs. A misreading shared by this script and the Rust reference would pass both. Mitigation: constants and the formula lines are checked against the origin text at generation and by `verify --origin`; the shader, the colour curves and the centre convention were read from their own blobs.
